title: The Middle Eastern Mezze Board
seo_title: Vegan Mezze Board for 6–8: Shopping List & Plan
description: A vegan Middle Eastern mezze board for 6–8: muhammara, dairy-free labneh, hummus, falafel, dolmas, za'atar flatbread, pistachios, dates and pomegranate.
hook: A mezze table on one board: smoky-sweet muhammara, tangy dairy-free labneh, falafel and dolmas, with dates, pistachios and pomegranate for color.
why: Mezze layers flavours rather than piling up one ingredient. Muhammara is sweet, smoky and a little spicy from roasted peppers and walnuts; the coconut labneh is cool and tangy; the hummus is mild and nutty. Guests can mix them on the same piece of flatbread.
Sumac, za'atar and lemon give the board its sour, herby edge, and dates and pomegranate seeds give it bursts of sweetness. Pistachios add crunch next to the soft falafel and dolmas.

timeline.what: Bake the falafel bites; take the dips out of the fridge.
Spoon the dips into bowls; dust the labneh with sumac and drizzle with za'atar oil.
Slice the cucumbers; warm the flatbread.
Place the dolmas, dates and tomatoes around the bowls.
Add the warm falafel, flatbread, pistachios, pomegranate and herbs.

faq.a: Yes, every item is plant-based. Check the labels on crackers, breads and store-bought dips, which sometimes contain butter, milk, honey or egg.

faq.q: How do I make dairy-free labneh?
faq.a: Spoon thick, unsweetened coconut or cashew yogurt into a strainer lined with cheesecloth, add a pinch of salt and let it drain in the fridge overnight.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 6 to 8 people as an appetizer, on a 16–20 inch board.
